review_description: Had the Connect boys install my solar system back in 2021, my bills have been minimal ever since and was well worth the investment.
Installation was a breeze, from start to finish. Couldn't have asked for a better experience.

The sales and quoting process was a breeze, Joe was able to answer all my solar questions.The boys were on time and polite and left the site how the found it.The post installation information process was just as easy.Couldn't have asked for a better experience.
Joe and his Connect Electrical team were such a pleasure to deal with. They were professional, neat and cleaned up after themselves. We are over the moon with our solar since it's been installed.
The process from start to finish was just made easy by the Connect team, the install was neat and tidy, the grid connection was also helped organized.

Joe has been nothing short of amazing while completing our quote, queries and installation of our system. He was able to clearly answer our many questions, was prompt and a pleasure to deal with. Would give more stars if I could
